name: ignore-tag-derives-no-configuration
description: The ignore tag derives no configuration, nor does any other tag of a file built only under it, so a derived matrix holds the host's alone, drops nothing, and lists no type error from the program the tag keeps out of the build. A file built only under the ignore tag is outside the analysis: nothing it declares is reported. The program run by hand roots what it names of the target. Elsewhere the run reports as it always does.
